_comment: Copy to config.json, then edit. Never put a key in here in plaintext: use ${ENV_VAR} or file:/absolute/path.

upstreams.name: agentrouter
upstreams.note: primary; passthrough reuses the client's own token, so no key to fill in

upstreams.name: backup-relay
upstreams.note: set base_url + the env var, then flip enabled to true

upstreams.name: official
upstreams.note: direct-to-Anthropic backstop; enable it and interruptions get very unlikely

_model_fallback_comment: Model-level switching. When a channel says it does not have the model, or the same model fails switch_after_attempts times in a row, walk the chain. Set enabled to false to always use exactly the model you asked for.
